main_topics.reason: The user began overwhelmed by conflicting food lists and kept asking how to navigate the diet and its phases.
The user worried they would have to avoid onions and garlic forever and later feared elimination would leave them with too little to eat.
The user asked how to carry out reintroduction and whether to do it with professional support.
The user asked whether the NHS would cover a dietitian referral for IBS and considered asking their GP.
The user questioned whether the Monash app was worth paying for but did not return to the cost after hearing about free alternatives.

output.summary: The user was overwhelmed by conflicting low-FODMAP food lists and worried the diet meant permanently giving up foods or being hungry. The assistant explained the diet phases, suggested the Monash app and asking the GP about a dietitian referral, and answered questions about reintroduction and food variety. The user restated a plan and said the conversation was genuinely helpful.
